description: Rb₃NaPbO₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.21 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.14 Å. In the third Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.32 Å. Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent PbO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.40 Å. Pb is bonded to four O atoms to form PbO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.11 Å) and one longer (2.12 Å) Pb-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Rb and one Pb atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ORb₅Pb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-71°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Rb, two equivalent Na, and one Pb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Rb, one Na, and one Pb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ORb₄NaPb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-71°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Rb, one Na, and one Pb atom.
